[tool-call write] {"path":"/Users/user/sigil-of-the-unwilling/game/scripts/probe/ScenarioPilot.gd","content":"class_name ScenarioPilot
extends BalanceProbe
## autopilot-matrix: сценарный автопилот — BalanceProbe + политика роли.
## Роль задаёт цель (goal_met), метрики (metrics) и опционально
## переопределяет поведение базового цикла через хуки (act,
## collect_target, enemy_target, on_battle_won).

var role: ScenarioRole

func start_scenario(class_id: String, role_id: String) -> void:
	var t: Dictionary = ScenarioTargets.role(role_id)
	if t.is_empty():
		_fail("role '%s' не определён" % role_id)
		return
	role = make_role(role_id, t)
	if role == null:
		_fail("не удалось создать роль '%s'" % role_id)
		return
	role.id = role_id
	role.target = t
	start_probe(class_id, int(t.get("max_turns", 60)))

## Фабрика ролей (D1): каждая роль — свой класс-политика.
static func make_role(role_id: String, target: Dictionary) -> ScenarioRole:
	match role_id:
		"collector":
			var r := CollectorRole.new()
			r.target = target
			return r
		"traveler":
			var r := TravelerRole.new()
			r.target = target
			return r
		"trader":
			var r := TraderRole.new()
			r.target = target
			return r
		"adventurer":
			var r := AdventurerRole.new()
			r.target = target
			return r
		"builder":
			var r := BuilderRole.new()
			r.target = target
			return r
	return null

## Редкие ресурсы (кристалл/самоцветы/золото) извлечено.
func rare_count() -> int:
	var ids: Array = [4, 5, 6]
	var n := 0
	for k in extracted_by_type.keys():
		if ids.has(int(k)):
			n += int(extracted_by_type[k])
	return n

func _step() -> void:
	if done:
		return
	if role != null and role.goal_met(self):
		goal_reached_turn = turn
		_finish()
		return
	if role != null and role.act(self):
		return
	super._step()

func _nearest_resource() -> Vector2i:
	if role != null:
		var t = role.collect_target(self)
		if t != null:
			return t
	return super._nearest_resource()

func _nearest_enemy() -> Vector2i:
	if role != null:
		var t = role.enemy_target(self)
		if t != null:
			return t
	return super._nearest_enemy()

func _on_battle_completed(winner: int, cell: Vector2i) -> void:
	super._on_battle_completed(winner, cell)
	if role != null and winner == BattleState.Side.ATTACKER:
		role.on_battle_won(self, cell)

## Подготовка мира (как в BalanceProbe.start_probe, но с seed по сценарию).
func prepare_world(cls: String, seed: int) -> void:
	var w: Node = get_tree().current_scene
	_world = w
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = seed
	var profile := HeroBuildProfile.new()
	profile.cls = cls
	profile.culture = "nord"
	profile.race = "human"
	profile.faction = "wanderers"
	profile.name = "Probe"
	profile.stats = {"str": 14, "dex": 12, "con": 14, "int": 12, "wis": 12, "cha": 12}
	var hero: Node = HeroController.new()
	hero.setup(profile, rng)
	w._hero = hero
	w._spawner = WorldSpawner.new()
	w._spawner.setup(w, rng)
	var rm := ResourceNodeManager.new()
	rm.setup(w, w._spawner, rng)
	w._resource_manager = rm
	var city_mgr := CityManager.new()
	city_mgr.setup(w, rng)
	w._city_manager = city_mgr
	var cm: Node = w._city_manager.capital
	w._city_manager.cities.append(cm)
	w._cities.append(cm)
	w._player_city = cm
	w._start_cell = cm.center
	hero._city = cm
	hero._city_cell = cm.center
	hero.cell = cm.center
	w._hero = hero
	w._map_gen = null
	# Спавнер сам создаст MapGen — даём ему seed через world
	w._rng = rng
	w._map_gen = MapGen.new()
	w._map_gen.setup(w, w._spawner, w._resource_manager, rng)
	w._map_gen.generate()
	var bc := BattleController.new()
	bc.setup(w, hero)
	w._battle_controller = bc
	var bte := BattleTurnExecutor.new()
	bte.setup(bc)
	w._battle_turn_executor = bte
	var es := EnemySpawner.new()
	es.setup(w, w._spawner)
	w._enemy_spawner = es
	var etp := EnemyTurnProcessor.new()
	etp.setup(w, es)
	w._enemy_turn_processor = etp
	var rsys := RelationshipSystem.new()
	rsys.setup(hero)
	hero._relationships = rsys
	var tds := TeamDialogSystem.new()
	tds.setup()
	hero._team_dialogs = tds
	hero._team_dialogs.load_dialogs()
	hero._succession = SuccessionController.new()
	hero._succession.setup()
	hero._endgame = EndgameController.new()
	hero._endgame.setup(w, hero)
	hero._event_router = WorldEventRouter.new()
	hero._event_router.setup(w, hero)
	w._event_router = hero._event_router
	hero._ui_manager = WorldUIManager.new()
	hero._ui_manager.setup(w, hero)
	# Соединяем сигналы (как в WorldBootstrap)
	GameEventBus.resource_extracted.connect(_on_resource_extracted)
	GameEventBus.battle_completed.connect(_on_battle_completed)
	GameEventBus.player_died.connect(_on_player_died)
	GameEventBus.battle_lost.connect(_on_battle_lost)
	GameEventBus.turn_ended.connect(_on_turn_ended)
	# Герой в городе
	hero._cell = cm.center
	hero._in_city = true
	# Fast mode
	ProbeFastMode.enable(w)
	# UI off
	var ui: Node = w.get_node_or_null("UI")
	if ui != null and ui.has_method("set_probe_mode"):
		ui.set_probe_mode(true)

func _ready() -> void:
	# Сценарный пилот запускается вручную (MCP), не из _ready
	pass

func report() -> Dictionary:
	var base: Dictionary = super.report()
	if role != null:
		base["role"] = role.id
		base["role_metrics"] = role.metrics(self)
		base["goal_reached"] = goal_reached_turn > 0
		base["goal_reached_turn"] = goal_reached_turn
	return base

func read_report_text() -> String:
	var r: Dictionary = report()
	var lines: PackedStringArray = []
	lines.append("=== ScenarioPilot report ===")
	lines.append("class: %s role: %s" % [str(r.get("class", "?")), str(r.get("role", "?"))])
	lines.append("turns: %d (max %d)" % [int(r.get("turns", 0)), int(r.get("max_turns", 0))])
	lines.append("goal: %s (turn %d)" % [str(r.get("goal_reached", false)), int(r.get("goal_reached_turn", 0))])
	lines.append("hp: %d/%d" % [int(r.get("hp", 0)), int(r.get("hp_max", 0))])
	lines.append("gold: %d" % [int(r.get("gold", 0))])
	lines.append("killed: %d lost: %d" % [int(r.get("killed", 0)), int(r.get("battles_lost", 0))])
	lines.append("extracted: %d" % [int(r.get("extracted_total", 0))])
	lines.append("buildings: %d" % [int(r.get("buildings_built", 0))])
	lines.append("recruits: %d" % [int(r.get("recruits", 0))])
	var rm: Dictionary = r.get("role_metrics", {})
	lines.append("--- role metrics ---")
	for k in rm.keys():
		lines.append(" %s: %s" % [k, str(rm[k])])
	lines.append("endgame: %s / %s" % [str(r.get("endgame_state", "")), str(r.get("endgame_reason", ""))])
	return "\n".join(lines)
"}

class_name ScenarioPilot
extends BalanceProbe
## autopilot-matrix: сценарный автопилот — BalanceProbe + политика роли.
## Роль задаёт цель (goal_met), метрики (metrics) и опционально
## переопределяет поведение базового цикла через хуки (act,
## collect_target, enemy_target, on_battle_won).

var role: ScenarioRole

func start_scenario(class_id: String, role_id: String) -> void:
	var t: Dictionary = ScenarioTargets.role(role_id)
	if t.is_empty():
		_fail("role '%s' не определён" % role_id)
		return
	role = make_role(role_id, t)
	if role == null:
		_fail("не удалось создать роль '%s'" % role_id)
		return
	role.id = role_id
	role.target = t
	start_probe(class_id, int(t.get("max_turns", 60)))

## Фабрика ролей (D1): каждая роль — свой класс-политика.
static func make_role(role_id: String, target: Dictionary) -> ScenarioRole:
	match role_id:
		"collector":
			var r := CollectorRole.new()
			r.target = target
			return r
		"traveler":
			var r := TravelerRole.new()
			r.target = target
			return r
		"trader":
			var r := TraderRole.new()
			r.target = target
			return r
		"adventurer":
			var r := AdventurerRole.new()
			r.target = target
			return r
		"builder":
			var r := BuilderRole.new()
			r.target = target
			return r
	return null

## Редкие ресурсы (кристалл/самоцветы/золото) извлечено.
func rare_count() -> int:
	var ids: Array = [4, 5, 6]
	var n := 0
	for k in extracted_by_type.keys():
		if ids.has(int(k)):
			n += int(extracted_by_type[k])
	return n

func _step() -> void:
	if done:
		return
	if role != null and role.goal_met(self):
		goal_reached_turn = turn
		_finish()
		return
	if role != null and role.act(self):
		return
	super._step()

func _nearest_resource() -> Vector2i:
	if role != null:
		var t = role.collect_target(self)
		if t != null:
			return t
	return super._nearest_resource()

func _nearest_enemy() -> Vector2i:
	if role != null:
		var t = role.enemy_target(self)
		if t != null:
			return t
	return super._nearest_enemy()

func _on_battle_completed(winner: int, cell: Vector2i) -> void:
	super._on_battle_completed(winner, cell)
	if role != null and winner == BattleState.Side.ATTACKER:
		role.on_battle_won(self, cell)

## Подготовка мира (как в BalanceProbe.start_probe, но с seed по сценарию).
func prepare_world(cls: String, seed: int) -> void:
	var w: Node = get_tree().current_scene
	_world = w
	var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	rng.seed = seed
	var profile := HeroBuildProfile.new()
	profile.cls = cls
	profile.culture = "nord"
	profile.race = "human"
	profile.faction = "wanderers"
	profile.name = "Probe"
	profile.stats = {"str": 14, "dex": 12, "con": 14, "int": 12, "wis": 12, "cha": 12}
	var hero: Node = HeroController.new()
	hero.setup(profile, rng)
	w._hero = hero
	w._spawner = WorldSpawner.new()
	w._spawner.setup(w, rng)
	var rm := ResourceNodeManager.new()
	rm.setup(w, w._spawner, rng)
	w._resource_manager = rm
	var city_mgr := CityManager.new()
	city_mgr.setup(w, rng)
	w._city_manager = city_mgr
	var cm: Node = w._city_manager.capital
	w._city_manager.cities.append(cm)
	w._cities.append(cm)
	w._player_city = cm
	w._start_cell = cm.center
	hero._city = cm
	hero._city_cell = cm.center
	hero.cell = cm.center
	w._hero = hero
	w._map_gen = null
	# Спавнер сам создаст MapGen — даём ему seed через world
	w._rng = rng
	w._map_gen = MapGen.new()
	w._map_gen.setup(w, w._spawner, w._resource_manager, rng)
	w._map_gen.generate()
	var bc := BattleController.new()
	bc.setup(w, hero)
	w._battle_controller = bc
	var bte := BattleTurnExecutor.new()
	bte.setup(bc)
	w._battle_turn_executor = bte
	var es := EnemySpawner.new()
	es.setup(w, w._spawner)
	w._enemy_spawner = es
	var etp := EnemyTurnProcessor.new()
	etp.setup(w, es)

	var rsys := RelationshipSystem.new()

	tds.setup()
	hero._team_dialogs = tds

	if ui != null and ui.has_method("set_probe_mode"):
		ui.set_probe_mode(true)
